name: Mahalunge
civicNote: Among the 23 villages added to PMC in 2021. PMRDA remains the planning authority for the Mahalunge-Maan town planning scheme.
summary: A developing area in Mulshi taluka west of Balewadi, between Pune city and Hinjewadi. Much of it falls under PMRDA's Mahalunge-Maan town planning scheme.
knownFor: Mahalunge-Maan Town Planning Scheme 1 (Hi-Tech City), prepared by PMRDA
Lies between Balewadi and the Hinjewadi-Maan IT area
connectivity: Pune Metro Line 3 (Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar) passes through neighbouring Balewadi
The TPS reserves about 50 ha for planned roads
suits: Buyers working in Hinjewadi or Balewadi who want newer development in a planned township area.
